_about: Human decisions on bills the weekly discovery scan scored 20-39 ('needs review'). A decided bill is never listed for review again. not_relevant / support_parked only silence the review list: a bill that later scores 40+ is still auto-added. track forces the bill in as provisional on the next scan. Decisions apply to one Congress, and a dismissed bill returns to review if it has a new action after decidedAt or its scoring data was incomplete. Written by .github/workflows/discovery-decision.yml from the links in the discovery email; see decisions/2026-10-09-discovery-review-decisions.md.
